name: en-context
description: Assembled prompts, in the shape a retrieval layer renders one. Three kinds of thing share a document: prose passages, headers carrying a file path (a home directory names its owner), and structure -- ids, hashes, offsets -- which is a negative set. Anything replaced there is a bug: a redacted hash is a package whose id no longer verifies. Smaller than the document sets on purpose; the large corpus of these lives in the development repository.

samples.note: An assembled prompt. The home directory names its owner in a form that appears nowhere else in the text; ids, hashes and offsets are negatives.
samples.annotated:
# SYSTEM
Answer the question using only the context provided below.
- Quote the exact text you rely on.
- Do not report character offsets.

# TASK
What happened with the [[COMPANY_NAME:Northwind Ltd]] quote?

# CONTEXT

[fbd4c2a631fd] /home/[[PERSON:p.doe]]/notes/meeting-log.md (Meeting)[464:562]
Met with [[PERSON:Priya Raman]] from [[COMPANY_NAME:Northwind Ltd]] on Tuesday. They asked for the quote to be reissued; [[PERSON:Michael Chen]] is handling it.

[92485203fd8a] //fileserver/team/2026/review.md (Open)[12:140]
Review notes for [[EMPLOYEE_ID:E-45033]] -- [[PERSON:Priya Raman]], born [[DATE_OF_BIRTH:1988-10-14]]. Transfer request to be considered against next quarter's 12 openings.

# NOT INCLUDED
2 relevant-looking passages were considered and left out of this context. Do not assume what you have been given is complete.

samples.note: Every system account a home-directory rule must refuse: a CI runner, a public profile, a service account. None of them is a person.
